notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34824130/fcb3dc74a9550a12fa1637f5b532e9a77f5e3793.png[/img]
New update is already available!

List of changes:
- the game has difficulty levels
- added a restart level button
- fixed animation monsters
- added options in pause mode
- fixed many bugs on Star Patrol
- updated images levels
- new effects mode
- fixed bugs on Closed Maze

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34824130/a07a8ff5a47c0f50c362efb5a7f77e85a7c01a76.png[/img]
New update is already available!

List of changes:
- fixed bugs on all maps
- in the pause mode, sounds from the level are no longer played
- traps can kill an infinite number of monsters
- fixed bug with pause
- fixed trap Press
- new hint on Claustrophobia
- a view type of flash drive on Star patrol
- fixed bug with opening doors on Star patrol
- monsters can open doors on Star patrol
- in the Closed maze, a flamethrower deals damage if a player walks nearby

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34824130/e0295d2633bec7ebc9af2fd0245692b197faee6b.png[/img]
Changes in the new update:
- added a damage multiplier (now if you shoot a monster in the head, it will die much faster)
- increased movement of monsters (they run 50% faster)
- lasers kill monsters
- in the game menu our musical composition plays
- new type of setting "vertical sync"
- added slider in the choice of levels
- there is a game icon on the window pane
